question: Estimate the customer support staff and content moderators needed for an Indian social media app at 200M MAU scale.
idealClarificationQuestions: Combined CS + content moderation + trust & safety staff? Yes.
At 200M MAU (e.g., a hypothetical Indian Twitter/Instagram-equivalent at this scale)? Yes.
Including outsourced (BPO + Indian language moderators)? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Industry ratios for moderators per MAU + CS staff.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Content moderation industry ratio: Facebook globally has ~15K moderators for ~3B users = 1 moderator per 200K users.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Plus customer support: ~0.005% of MAU contact CS daily = 10K daily tickets; agents needed: ~250 active across shifts = ~750 total.

benchmarkAssumptions.value: Facebook globally has ~15K moderators for ~3B users = 1 moderator per 200K users.
~0.005% of MAU contact CS daily = 10K daily tickets; agents needed: ~250 active across shifts = ~750 total.

calculationFlow: Content moderation industry ratio: Facebook globally has ~15K moderators for ~3B users = 1 moderator per 200K users.
But including all 22 Indian languages and high-volume short-video review: scale up 1.5x = ~3,000 moderators.
Plus customer support: ~0.005% of MAU contact CS daily = 10K daily tickets; agents needed: ~250 active across shifts = ~750 total.
